Scheduled: Verizon Q3 on Oct 26 and T-Mobile Q3 on Oct 28, the main reads on wireless pricing; Verizon has been buying share, so a strong Verizon add number is a modest negative for T and a soft one a relief. Unscheduled but likely: more SpaceX news on Starlink Mobile (the Oct 23 -8% followed a Bloomberg report that SpaceX seeks access to 80,000+ US cell sites, relayed by Motley Fool) and FCC steps on the SpaceX-Grain 800 MHz deal; each recent SpaceX headline cost T 8-11% in a day, so the left tail is fatter than usual. Against that, the stock is near its 52-week low after an EPS beat and raise, where short-horizon reversal and the 5.3% yield attract buyers.
